title: So I was disappointed it’s a piece of material with buttons on top ...
text:
So I was disappointed it’s a piece of material with buttons on top .... I did no not what a duvet is I though it was French for bedspread. So I was disappointed it’s a piece of material with buttons on top which I cannot figure out why. For the price I only give 2 stars.
It does have beautiful color

product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR Poplar Duvet Cover Set, Single-Ply Authentic 300 Thread Count, Full/Queen
features: Well made of 100% premium cotton; single ply; Luxurious 300-Thread-Count
Duvet cover features button closure for elegant sharp look
Cotton is Soft, comfortable, breathable and durable
Full/Queen set includes 90-by-92-inch duvet cover; 20-by-26-inch 2 pillow shams
description: This soft and smooth 100% cotton duvet cover is reversible and gives you two great looks in one, allowing you to refresh your bedroom decor with one quick flip of the duvet. The deep indigos and rich wines in this duvet cover set are perfect for creating that dramatic look you've always wanted. The 300 Thread Count cotton is strong, durable, and if cared for properly, will be long lasting.
